messages:
alice: deploy-bot alerted — auth-service image push shows provenance mismatch between us-east-1 and us-west-2 for tag 2026.03.20-rc2. deploy-bot blocked the rollout. anyone touch the publish pipeline?

deploy-bot: [alert] image-provenance-check failed for 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/auth-service:2026.03.20-rc2 - expected sha256:abcd1234... got sha256:ef01abcd... -> deploy blocked to prod. job=images/provenance-check #342

ben: that was me — I re-pushed a candidate to the same tag to fix a CI flake. Oof, didn't realize registry replication hadn't finished.

carla: can we confirm the manifests/digests in both regions? quick command I ran elsewhere: `aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name auth-service --image-ids imageTag=2026.03.20-rc2 --region us-west-2 --query 'images[].imageId.imageDigest'`

sam: ran checks: us-east digest=sha256:abcd1234def..., us-west digest=sha256:ef01abcd998... looks like tag pointed to different manifests for ~3 minutes during replication/retag window.

alice: deploy-bot already blocked canary. proposal: pin prod to the known-good digest (sha256:abcd1234def...) and have ben push a new immutable tag for the newer image (e.g., 2026.03.20-rc2-rebuild) with proper cosign signing. everyone OK?

ben: +1. I'll push `2026.03.20-rc2-rebuild` and sign. Also will add build metadata to provenance so we never reuse the same tag without a build id. I'll avoid reusing canonical release tags.

rachel: also update the release note and the change window ticket. We should add a short runbook entry: never retag a release candidate tag in different regions. And a CI guard to refuse overwriting an existing tag.

carla: cosign verify failed on the bad region, sample output attached:
```
$ cosign verify --key k8s-prod-keyring.pem docker://123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/auth-service:2026.03.20-rc2
Verification for docker://...: FAILED
ERROR: signature digest mismatch
```

ben: pushing new image tag now and will publish manifest with explicit digest pin: `aws ecr put-image --repository-name auth-service --image-tag 2026.03.20-rc2-rebuild --image-manifest file://manifest.json --region us-east-1` then cosign sign. will ping when done.

deploy-bot: image-provenance-check succeeded for auth-service:2026.03.20-rc2-rebuild (job=images/provenance-check #343). Promotion to canary remains blocked pending infra approval.

alice: thanks. infra, can you pin prod to sha256:abcd1234def... and hold the deployment window until we confirm the new tag is fully propagated? Add a release-note bullet: DO NOT REUSE TAGS — use immutable tags or include build id.

eng-oncall: done — prod pinned to sha256:abcd1234def..., rollout held. Created release note line and ops runbook PR to document the guard.

sam: filing follow-up ticket CI-987: enforce tag immutability and make promote action fail if tag exists within last X minutes. Will include an optional `--force-overwrite` for emergencies logged to audit.

rachel: creating short blameless postmortem and linking CI-987 + runbook PR. Thanks for the quick reaction everyone. Closing thread once CI-987 is filed.
